comments.mergedPostDetails:
100% Reproduction

 

1. Launch VRChat (make sure you have switched to the problematic avatar before opening).

2. Open the menu.

3. Open the Avatar option.

4. Select a normal Avatar.

5. Switch to the problematic Avatar.

6. Trigger a random event.

7. The issue is reproduced.

Video1(1820)&Video2(1830) In https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_gCr5jWQOZoB2kxKqVsdAml0XFvSdUgY?usp=drive_link

————————————————————————————————————

Probable Reproduction

 

1. Launch VRC. (Ensure that you have switched to the problematic avatar.)

2. Open the menu.

3. Join a random world.

4. Ensure not to change the Avatar midway.

5. This issue may trigger randomly.

Video3 In https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_gCr5jWQOZoB2kxKqVsdAml0XFvSdUgY?usp=drive_link————————————————————————————————————

0% Reproduction

 

1. Launch VRC, ensure the currently selected avatar is not the problematic one.

2. Open the menu.

3. Join a random world.

4. No matter how many attempts are made, the issue will never occur.

————————————————————————————————————

Please be sure to check the Discord link below for more details.

https://discord.com/channels/189511567539306508/1496819857885233233

The attachment is the performance chart.
